proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.ability_modifier
proposed_widenings.justification: Nature's Veil use count is Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Existing UseCountCap only supports fixed integer or threshold_tiers keyed on class level. An ability-score-derived cap is a distinct shape with no existing representation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once)

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect.apply_condition
proposed_widenings.justification: Nature's Veil grants the Invisible condition to self until end of next turn. ClassFeatureEffect only covers grant_extra_action and heal_hp. An apply_condition variant (target=self, condition, duration) is required. The v4 atom apply_condition exists; only the surface ClassFeatureEffect union is missing it.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can give yourself the Invisible condition until the end of your next turn

proposed_widenings.name: Condition.invisible
proposed_widenings.justification: Condition is currently a single-value union ('prone'). The Invisible condition is a standard SRD condition needed here and will recur across many stealth/illusion features.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can give yourself the Invisible condition

notes: Family (activation, class_feature), activation cost (bonus_action), and reset cadence (long_rest) all fit cleanly. Three surface variants are missing: (1) ability-modifier-derived UseCountCap, (2) apply_condition in ClassFeatureEffect, (3) 'invisible' in Condition. No atom_widening — apply_condition and use_count are both v4 atoms; only the surface encoding shapes are absent. The timed expiry shape (until end of next turn) would also need representation in a ClassFeatureEffect.apply_condition variant, which is a fourth surface gap but minor given turn_end_window already exists in v4.
